name: Room 1
description: Room 1 is the largest room on the north-west corner of the second floor measuring 20 ft by 15 ft. It houses 4 large desks easily accommodaing 4 employees. This room is spacious leaving sufficient space around desks. Each desk has 3 drawers and 1 panel cabinet for storing stationery and other items. The entrance and front desk on the ground floor may also be viewed through the glass wall.

name: Room 2
description: Room 2 measures 12 ft by 12 ft and is suitable for 3 employees. It houses 3 desks where each desk comes with 3 drawers and 1 panel cabinet.

name: Room 3

name: Room 4
description: Room 4 measures 9 ft by 11 ft and is suitable for 2 employees. It houses 2 desks where each desk comes with 3 drawers. The open space and the work desks may be viewed through the glass wall of this room.

name: Room 6
